description: First-class claim tag lenses for CKA extractors. Stored on claim tags[] (same string-array model as BoC docs/TAGS_AND_MEME_OCCURRENCES.md). Protocol JSON schema extension deferred until first CKA extract batch.

claim_lenses.label: Calls for tips
claim_lenses.description: Host asks the audience to submit tips, leads, or on-the-ground reporting.

claim_lenses.label: Decentralized investigation / DIA-style asks
claim_lenses.description: Explicit audience-side investigation, crowdsourcing, or DIA-framed collaborative inquiry.

claim_lenses.label: Open source investigation / OSINT
claim_lenses.description: OSINT methods, public records, social traces, or teach-the-audience sourcing steps.

claim_lenses.label: Submissions to Candace
claim_lenses.description: Material sent to the show, exclusives, whistleblower handoffs, or tips received by the production.

extractor_notes: Apply zero or more lens ids to claim tags[] when the claim is primarily about that meta-behavior (in addition to topical tags like timeline, falsifiable, etc.).
